`tally --version` prints only the package version. Released packages carry `release-source.json` at the package root with the `sourceCommit` they were built from. Add `tally --version --verbose` (and `-v --verbose`) that prints the version and, when `release-source.json` is present beside `package.json`, the full source commit and repository on a second line; when the file is absent (a source checkout), print `source: development checkout`. Plain `tally --version` must print exactly what it prints today. The change belongs in `cli/main.ts`; add a test next to `cli/version.test.ts` covering all three cases. Typecheck, build and the full suite must stay green.

Run this verification command before claiming success: npm test
